# Damage Intelligence

> Multi-tenant, AI-assisted vehicle damage detection and inspection platform for rental (GCU365 CROMS) and workshop (GCU365Maintenance) operations. It manages inspection evidence, AI advisory damage findings, before/after trip comparison, review queues, and damage cases. AI outputs are advisory only; final liability, customer charge, and repair cost remain with CROMS / Maintenance / Finance.

## Core capabilities

- [Trip Inspection](https://damage-cases.emergent.host/): Anonymous before/after walkaround analysis with bounding-box damage markers, severity, size and repair/replace advice, condition and cleanliness scores, and branded bilingual (English/Arabic) PDF reports.
- [Inspections](https://damage-cases.emergent.host/inspections): Inspection sessions, evidence capture, and AI damage detection.
- [Review Queue](https://damage-cases.emergent.host/review): Human-in-the-loop review of low-confidence AI findings.
- [Damage Cases](https://damage-cases.emergent.host/cases): Persisted advisory damage cases linked to findings, with handoff to maintenance.

## Notes

- Authentication is required for all operational screens; the platform is a B2B operator console, not a public website.
- Currency is Saudi Riyal (SAR). Pricing estimates are advisory.
